news.title: Desperate LA renters are turning to an unlikely generation to beat sky-high housing costs
news.description: LA’s housing shortage is leading many renters to make an unexpected solution: Moving in with a roommate from a completely different generation.

news.title: Jio parent Reliance Industries breaks silence on Starlink row: 'We have never feared competition’
news.description: Reliance Industries said it welcomes competition, including Starlink, and has never feared rivals. The company emphasized that all satellite communication providers must follow Indian laws and policies, noting that Jio’s own satellite services are awaiting go…

news.title: ‘Gotta Be the Worst Announcer in Sports,’ ‘Needs To Retire’ — NFL Fans Take Issue With Al Michaels’ Lack of ‘Enthusiasm’ During Broncos-Seahawks
news.description: It’s another Thursday Night Football game, and Al Michaels once again drew criticism from the viewers. Fans weren’t thrilled with Michaels’s lack of energy when calling two of the better teams in the NFL: the Denver Broncos and the Seattle Seahawks.
